identitySignals: Name matches a single, distinctive law firm: McCormick Barstow LLP (mccormickbarstow.com), matching the agenda's 'McCormick Barstow Law Firm'
The firm's website lists school districts as a client industry and describes legal services for them, consistent with OUSD's 'Legal, insurance & risk' contracts through the General Counsel's office
Weak point: the agenda gives no city, and no public page found links this firm to Oakland Unified; the firm lists no Bay Area office
research.notes: Identity rests on the name and practice-area match only; no registry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was checked and no page ties the firm to OUSD. Reviewer should confirm via OUSD contract documents before publishing.

profile.summary: A law firm headquartered in Fresno, California, with offices in other California cities, Nevada and Ohio. It advises businesses, public entities and school districts on matters such as litigation, labor and employment, real estate and insurance defense.
